metaDescription: Order custom tri blend nursing scrubs in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Soft, durable fabric with your logo. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines cotton, polyester, and rayon for a soft feel and excellent durability, making it a top choice for healthcare uniforms. Custom tri blend nursing scrubs resist wrinkles and fading through frequent washing, keeping your team looking professional shift after shift. Ideal for hospitals and clinics ordering in bulk, these scrubs accept embroidery or screen printing with crisp results.
